reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: createGeneration is a live route registered at src/index.ts:75 — non-zero non-test callers. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json defines no trust_assumptions; the REST API endpoint is in-scope and input validation is an explicit key security concern. Gate 3: src/api/generation.ts is explicitly in-scope. The only guard is `if (!generation)` (L12), a falsy check that passes negative integers (e.g. -1) and non-integer floats (e.g. 1.5) because `!(-1) === false`; no Number.isInteger() call exists anywhere in the file. An attacker can trigger this via POST /api/generation with a valid API_AUTH_TOKEN by sending {"generation": -1}, causing Discord to create a role named "-1期生" and inserting a malformed row into generation_roles, corrupting role-management state. Severity MEDIUM is unchanged: impact is concrete state corruption but exploitation requires a valid or stolen bearer token.
